basics.name: Jane Doe
basics.label: Senior Product Manager
basics.summary: Product leader with 10+ years shipping data platforms, SaaS products, and AI-powered features into production. Combines deep domain expertise in financial technology with modern product management practices — accelerating delivery through quantitative decision-making and cross-functional execution. Grew platform revenue from $5MM to $25MM+, scaled enterprise adoption to 200+ accounts, and closed critical quality gaps from 90% to 99.5%.

work.name: Acme Corp
highlights: Grew the company's data platform from **$5MM** to **$25MM+** annual revenue through new product launches and expanded enterprise partnerships.
Launched **Acme Insights**, an AI-powered analytics product, from concept to **$8MM** ARR in 18 months — now the company's fastest-growing product line.
Established the Platform Engineering team's product practice, reducing average feature delivery time by **40%** through improved requirements and prioritization.
Led adoption of OKR-based planning across 4 engineering teams, increasing feature hit rate from **60%** to **90%** quarter-over-quarter.

work.name: Acme Corp
highlights: Delivered the company's first REST API product, adopted by **75+** enterprise customers in the first year.
Drove migration from legacy monolith to microservices architecture, reducing deployment time from **3 hours** to **15 minutes**.
Founded the Product Analytics function, establishing data-driven decision-making across 3 product teams.

work.name: TechCorp Solutions
highlights: Product lead for **TradeFlow**, an enterprise fixed-income trading platform serving **50+** institutional clients.
Delivered a complete redesign of the portfolio analytics module, increasing daily active users by **120%**.
Reduced trade settlement errors by **35%** through a redesigned validation workflow and real-time exception alerts.

work.name: DataFirst Inc.
highlights: Product founder of **[InsightHub](https://insighthub.datafirst.io/)** , a web platform serving **500K+** daily data requests to **2,000+** subscribers.
Designed and shipped industry-first visualization tools, including interactive market data dashboards and automated reporting workflows.
Won **"Best Data Product"** award in 2013 and 2014.
